'''Javier Andorrà Julia''' (born 7 June 1985) is an Andorran international [[association football|footballer]] who plays for the B-team of [[FC Andorra]] as a [[Forward (association football)|forward]].

==Career==
He has played for [[FC Andorra]], [[CD Benicarló]], [[CF Gimnástico Alcázar]], [[CD Binéfar]], [[Inter Club d'Escaldes]] and [[FC Lusitanos]].<ref name = "NFT">{{NFT player|pid=11715|access-date=16 November 2018}}</ref>

He made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in 2005.<ref name = "NFT"/>
